_note: Diabetes SVM is trained on the FULL 81k training set (not a subsample); a subsample understates RF/SVM error convergence. Local re-run (sklearn 1.8) reproduces the paper's Diabetes-SVM effect to within SVM library drift: phi 0.283->0.665, disagreement 45.0->23.8%, under-prediction +2.6pp here vs the paper's phi->0.696, 21.4%, +3.1pp (SVM/libsvm results are sensitive to BLAS/library versions). The qualitative result is identical: substituting a convergent SVM for the kNN partner collapses productive disagreement and degrades under-prediction. UNSW-NB15 values are the original-environment results.
